name: Filter Form
Dispatch Queries
func:
var p = msg.payload || {};
var start_date = p.start_date || '2024-03-13 00:00:00';
var end_date = p.end_date || '2024-03-19 23:59:59';
var quality_flag = p.quality_flag || 'OK';
var granularity = p.granularity || 'daily';

var params = {
    start_date: start_date,
    end_date: end_date,
    quality_flag: quality_flag
};

var time_fmt = "%Y-%m-%d";
if (granularity === 'hourly') time_fmt = "%Y-%m-%d %H:00";
else if (granularity === 'weekly') time_fmt = "%Y-%U";

var q1_sql = "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '" + time_fmt + "') AS time_bucket, " +
    "member_casual, COUNT(*) AS trip_count " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "GROUP BY time_bucket, member_casual " +
    "ORDER BY time_bucket ASC;";

var q2_sql = "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS trip_date, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0), 2) AS total_energy_kwh, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(energy_kwh), 0), 3) AS avg_energy_kwh, " +
    "COUNT(*) AS ebike_trips " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE rideable_type = 'electric_bike' " +
    "AND started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "GROUP BY trip_date " +
    "ORDER BY trip_date ASC;";

var q3_sql = "SELECT member_casual, COUNT(*) AS total_trips, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(duration_s), 0) / 3600.0, 1) AS total_hours, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(duration_s), 0) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_duration_min, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN duration_s < 300 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS under_5m, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN duration_s BETWEEN 300 AND 899 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m5_to_15m, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN duration_s BETWEEN 900 AND 1799 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m15_to_30m, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN duration_s BETWEEN 1800 AND 3599 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS m30_to_60m, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN duration_s >= 3600 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_60m " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "GROUP BY member_casual;";

var q4_sql = "SELECT " +
    "CASE " +
    "  WHEN TIME(started_at) BETWEEN '07:00:00' AND '09:59:59' THEN 'Morning (07-10h)' " +
    "  WHEN TIME(started_at) BETWEEN '10:00:00' AND '15:59:59' THEN 'Midday (10-16h)' " +
    "  WHEN TIME(started_at) BETWEEN '16:00:00' AND '18:59:59' THEN 'Evening (16-19h)' " +
    "  ELSE 'Night (19-07h)' " +
    "END AS time_window, " +
    "COUNT(*) AS trip_count, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(duration_s), 0) / 60.0, 1) AS avg_duration_min, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(energy_kwh), 0), 2) AS total_kwh " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "GROUP BY time_window " +
    "ORDER BY time_window ASC;";

var q5_sql = "SELECT DATE_FORMAT(started_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS trip_date, member_casual, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0), 2) AS total_revenue_usd, " +
    "ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(cost_usd), 0), 2) AS avg_cost_usd " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "GROUP BY trip_date, member_casual " +
    "ORDER BY trip_date ASC, member_casual;";

var q6_sql = "SELECT COALESCE(start_station_name, 'Unknown Station') AS station_name, " +
    "COUNT(*) AS departures, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN rideable_type = 'electric_bike' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ebike_departures, " +
    "SUM(CASE WHEN member_casual = 'member' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS member_departures " +
    "FROM trips " +
    "WHERE started_at >= :start_date AND started_at <= :end_date " +
    "AND (quality_flag = :quality_flag OR :quality_flag = 'ALL') " +
    "AND start_station_name IS NOT NULL " +
    "GROUP BY start_station_name " +
    "ORDER BY departures DESC " +
    "LIMIT 10;";

return [
    { topic: q1_sql, payload: params },
    { topic: q2_sql, payload: params },
    { topic: q3_sql, payload: params },
    { topic: q4_sql, payload: params },
    { topic: q5_sql, payload: params },
    { topic: q6_sql, payload: params }
];
